description: Use this when the user asks what it costs to send a physical letter by post (snail mail), including a registered letter. Returns the exact total incl. VAT (for a signed-in EU business customer with a confirmed VAT number: excl. VAT under the reverse charge), the line items, the envelope, the postal size class and zone and the typical delivery time for a page count, destination country and print options. Letters are printed and posted in Europe, so the sender can be anywhere in the world. Note: registered mail is international registered mail with tracking and signature on delivery; "certified" letters, Einschreiben, lettre recommandée and carta certificada mean this here (not a US certified-mail product). Works without sign-in. Set currency to get the total in USD, GBP or CHF (ECB rate plus currency margin). Does not cover email, fax, parcels or postcards.

color.description: "bw" = black and white, "color" = colour printing (costs more per page). Default "bw".

country.description: Destination country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE, FR or US (list_destinations lists them all).

currency.description: Currency for the total: "EUR", "USD", "GBP" or "CHF". Prices are set in EUR; for USD, GBP or CHF the result adds the total converted at the ECB rate plus a currency margin. Default "EUR".

duplex.description: true = print on both sides of the paper (fewer sheets, so a lighter letter); false = one side only. Default false.

envelope.description: "DL" (220×110 mm, letter folded twice), "C5" (229×162 mm, folded once) or "C4" (324×229 mm, flat). Omit to use the smallest envelope that holds the sheets (recommended); one too small for the page count is refused.

pages.description: Number of pages in the PDF, a whole number from 1 to 250, e.g. 2.

postal_code.description: Destination postcode, e.g. 07001. Optional: it only changes the price for the Spanish and Portuguese islands and enclaves (Balearic and Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla, Madeira, Azores).

registered.description: true = registered mail: tracking number and signature on delivery, for an extra fee (also what "certified" letters, Einschreiben, lettre recommandée and carta certificada mean here; not a US certified-mail product). false = ordinary mail. Default false.
